traits.name: Black Tongue
traits.description: The priest's tongue and teeth were charred black the moment it spoke Noc'tra aloud during the Utterance Ritual and lived. Its voice now cracks and rasps like grinding stone, and it has Advantage on Charisma (Intimidation) checks against any creature that can hear it speak.

traits.name: Curse-Marked
traits.description: Having survived a taste of the Great Lich's whisper, the priest's nerves are already broken to the sound of oblivion. It has Resistance to Necrotic damage and cannot be Frightened.

actions.name: Curse-Etched Stave
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) Bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) Necrotic damage as curse-fire crawls from the wood into the wound.

actions.name: Curse-Throat Wail (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The priest looses a rasping shout amplified by the brass throat-tube lashed across its ruined mouth. Each creature in a 15-foot cone must make a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw, taking 10 (3d6) Psychic damage and gaining the Frightened condition until the end of the priest's next turn on a failed save, or half as much damage only on a successful one.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.description: The priest casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 12, +3 to hit with spell attacks): At will: Thaumaturgy, Toll the Dead. 2/Day each: Hold Person, Silence. 1/Day: Bestow Curse.

bonus_actions.name: Command the Accursed
bonus_actions.description: The priest chooses any number of Accursed it can see within 30 feet of it. Each chosen Accursed can immediately take the Attack action or move up to its Speed toward a point the priest designates, per the Accursed's Directed by the Faithful trait.

combatants.name: Accursed Brute (Physical Accursed)
combatants.languages: Understands the language it knew in life but can't speak
combatants.description: A more physically imposing Accursed, with a stronger body.

traits.name: Herd-Bound
traits.description: While within 5 feet of at least one other Accursed creature, the Accursed Brute has Advantage on saving throws against being frightened or charmed.

actions.name: Smash
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) Bludgeoning damage.

combatants.name: Accursed Warden (Armored Accursed)
combatants.languages: Maybe understands the language it knew in life but can't speak
combatants.description: A more physically imposing Accursed, with a stronger body and some crude armor.

traits.name: Herd-Bound
traits.description: While within 5 feet of at least one other Accursed creature, the Accursed Brute has Advantage on saving throws against being frightened and against effects that would move it against its will.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The Accursed Warden makes two Rusted Halberd attacks.

actions.name: Rusted Halberd
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 10 ft. Hit: 5 (1d10) Slashing damage.

combatants.name: Accursed Group (Accursed Group (5))
combatants.languages: Understands the languages its bodies knew in life but can't speak

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: 50-41: 5 attacks, 40-31: 4 attacks, 30-21: 3 attacks, 20-11: 2 attacks, 10-1: 1 attack. An attack can be either a Smash or a Grab.

actions.name: Smash
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) Bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Grab
actions.description: reach 5 ft. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 13).

bonus_actions.name: Rush
bonus_actions.description: The Accursed Group of 3 can dash as a bonus action on it's first turn of combat.
